summary:
Iteration 5 (backend only) — verified 3 production quality bug fixes on preview backend. All 49 tests pass (37 prior + 12 new).

Primary AI feature (POST /api/chat via emergentintegrations + gpt-5.2): pass.

BUG 1 (PSCRB Vizag location-specific fee) — 4 new tests pass. Evidence: 'PSCRB Vizag fees' -> status=grounded, answer='- Proficiency in Survival Craft & Rescue Boats (PSCRB) — 5 Days — ₹ 6,900 (Vizag)\n\nhttps://himtmarine.com/vizag-course/', sources include https://himtmarine.com/vizag-course/. Same result for 'PSCRB course fees in Vizag' and 'PSCRB course at Vizag'. REGRESSION: 'PSCRB course at Chennai' -> status=grounded, answer does NOT contain '(vizag)' tag and top source is NOT /vizag-course/ (top src=/discounted-package/, answer says 'Chennai-specific fee isn't explicitly shown; fees may differ by campus').

BUG 2 (Required documents) — 5 new tests pass. Evidence: 'Documents needed for booking' -> status=grounded, intent=documents, answer lists '- Copy of original 10th mark sheet\n- Copy of Passport\n- Passport size photo (white background)' and cites https://himtmarine.com/faq/. Same for 'Documents needed for booking a course', 'Required documents for admission', 'What documents are required for admission?', 'Required documents for HIMT'. No 'don't have that specific information' refusals.

BUG 3 (Value-added courses format) — 3 new tests pass. Evidence: 'Value added courses list' -> status=grounded, answer is a clean bullet list of 10 courses (each line starts with '- ' and uses ' — ' separators for name/duration/fee), cites https://himtmarine.com/value-added-courses/. No 'is available from ... with fees ...' narrative prose. Same for 'List of value added courses' and 'What are the value-added courses?'.

REGRESSION (previous grounded intents still work): TestChatCampusAddress (3), TestChatBookingLink (3), TestChat about/contact/courses/admissions/insufficient/cache — all pass. Admin auth/stats/facts/logs/reingest, leads CRUD + admin PATCH, chat lead-capture flag, admin scheduler — all pass.

Flaky TestHealth::test_health_ok fix: updated to accept latest_ingestion.status in ('completed','running') to avoid xdist race with TestAdminReingest. Now stable.

Skills loaded: ai-testing-core, ai-testing-llm.
critical_code_review_comments: retrieval.py score_chunk now takes query_lower and applies LOCATION_URL_BOOST/PENALTY — clean implementation. Only Vizag is mapped; if Kalpakkam gets its own campus page in future, add it too so 'Chennai vs Kalpakkam' fee mixing does not happen.

retrieval.py detect_intent: 'documents' short-circuit uses hard-coded doc_words list overlapping INTENT_MAP['documents']. Consider making that a single source of truth (STRONG_INTENT_TRIGGERS['documents']) to avoid drift.

server.py _build_user_prompt DOCUMENT-INTENT HINT hardcodes the 3 INDoS docs in the prompt. This is safe today (they match the FAQ page), but if the FAQ page updates the document list, the hint will silently go stale. Consider deriving the list from a small structured fact in retrieval.py get_structured_facts.
server.py Rule 11 ('COURSE LISTINGS' format) works — value-added output now uses '- Name — Duration — Fee'. Rule wording 'omit fields that are missing' is being respected; good.
server.py: `import re` at line 476 still not moved to top-level imports (cosmetic, called out iter 3+4).
seed_data_creation: Chat answer_cache now contains 12 new grounded entries for the iteration-5 bug-fix queries (Vizag/Chennai PSCRB, documents variants, value-added-courses list variants). A few TEST_-prefixed leads created by TestLeads/TestAdminLeads (as in prior iterations). No production data modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite is now 49 tests in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py. Three new classes added in iteration 5: TestChatPSCRBVizagFees (4 tests including Chennai regression), TestChatRequiredDocuments (5 tests), TestChatValueAddedCoursesListFormat (3 tests). TestHealth::test_health_ok now accepts latest_ingestion.status in ('completed','running') — no longer flaky under xdist. Real gpt-5.2 via emergentintegrations remains configured and working. Preview backend URL: https://himt-assistant-bot.preview.emergentagent.com. Note per review_request: 'Value added courses fees' by itself is EXPECTED to return insufficient (source page does not list per-course fees for VAC) — do not add that as a positive test.
rca of the issue:
BUG 1 (PSCRB Vizag fee mixing) RCA: Prior retrieval had no location bias — a query like 'PSCRB Vizag fees' would score the /advanced-modular-courses/ Chennai page equally (or higher) than /vizag-course/, so the LLM would happily emit a Chennai-page fee. Fix (retrieval.py) adds LOCATION_URL_BOOST['vizag']=['/vizag-course'] and LOCATION_URL_PENALTY['vizag']=['/basic-modular','/advanced-modular','/competency-courses','/simulator-based','/revalidation-upgradation'], and score_chunk now applies them when 'vizag' or 'visakhapatnam' is in the query. Combined with server.py Rule 10 ('LOCATION-SPECIFIC FEES: use ONLY the fee from THAT campus source'), the model now returns the Vizag ₹6,900 and tags it '(Vizag)'. Chennai queries are untouched — no top-source displacement.

BUG 2 (Required documents 'I don't have that info') RCA: Prior intent map had no 'documents' intent; 'Documents needed for booking' fell into 'admissions' whose top chunks (/booking-procedures) narrate the booking flow without an explicit document list. Fix (retrieval.py) adds INTENT_MAP['documents'] with keywords (document/papers/certificates/indos/cdc/coc/passport/mark sheet/photo), INTENT_URL_PATTERNS['documents']=['/faq','/submission-procedure','/booking-procedures'], and a documents short-circuit in detect_intent. server.py _build_user_prompt now injects a DOCUMENT-INTENT HINT listing the 3 INDoS docs plus Rule 12. Verified: intent='documents', /faq/ cited, all 3 doc items listed.

BUG 3 (Value-added narrative prose) RCA: Prior SYSTEM_PROMPT had no formatting rule for course listings, so the LLM defaulted to prose ('X is available from Y with fees Z') for value-added courses whose only structured attribute is duration+optional fee. Fix (server.py Rule 11) mandates '- Course Name — Duration — Fee' bullet format for listing intents. Verified: 10 bullet lines, no 'is available from ... with fees ...' prose, /value-added-courses/ cited.

All fixes correctly scoped, backward-compatible, and all 37 prior tests still pass alongside the 12 new ones.
